I have farmed in Oromia for over forty years, and even at sixty I still work this small maize plot because it helps feed my household. I will apply DAP and urea from the cooperative, though I can only afford a modest amount this season, and I will spread manure from my animals as well. I will plant local maize seed that I saved from last year since improved seed is too expensive, and I will rely on my family for labor rather than paying workers or buying chemicals and irrigation.
